title: PCAOB Inspection Report — Deloitte & Touche LLP (2024)
description: PCAOB Release No. 104-2025-036. Tailored to this specific firm inspection.

report_date.description: Publication date printed on the cover.

firm_inspected.description: Audit firm whose engagements were inspected.

firm_headquarters.description: Firm HQ city/state as printed on the cover.

inspection_year.description: Calendar year the inspection cycle covers.

audits_reviewed_count.description: Total number of issuer audits reviewed this inspection cycle.

part_1a_deficiencies_count.description: Number of audits with at least one Part I.A deficiency.

part_1a_deficiency_rate_percent.description: Percent of reviewed audits with at least one Part I.A deficiency. Derived — requires computing part_1a_deficiencies_count / audits_reviewed_count.

audit_areas_most_frequently_reviewed.description: Rows of the 'Audit Areas Most Frequently Reviewed' table in the Inspection Approach section.

inspection_results_by_issuer_revenue_ran.description: Each bar/row of the 'Inspection Results by Issuer Revenue Range' chart or table — read values off the chart if no table is present.

part_1a_deficiencies.description: Every distinct deficiency described in Part I.A. One entry per deficiency narrative.

quality_control_criticisms_count.description: Count of Part II quality-control criticisms, or null if the Part II section is redacted from this public version.

is_public_version_redacted.description: True if the cover page indicates portions have been omitted to comply with Sarbanes-Oxley disclosure rules.

as2401_deficiency_count.description: Number of Part I.A deficiencies that cite PCAOB auditing standard AS 2401 (Consideration of Fraud). Requires filtering the part_1a_deficiencies array by standard_cited.

highest_frequency_audit_area.description: The audit area with the highest Part I.A deficiency count in the Audit Areas Most Frequently Reviewed table. Requires reading the table and picking the argmax row.

highest_deficiency_revenue_band.description: Revenue band with the highest deficiency rate from the Inspection Results by Issuer Revenue Range chart. Requires reading the chart (no table may be present).

consecutive_auditor_years_cited_in_narra.description: The number of consecutive years Deloitte has served as the issuer's auditor, as mentioned in the specific deficiency narrative in Section 26 about engagement tenure. Very localized lookup.

revenue_recognition_deficiencies_tested_.description: For the revenue-related deficiency narratives, did the firm test any controls over the unsatisfied performance obligations? Requires reading the Revenue deficiency description and answering its boolean.

prior_year_comparison_mentioned.description: Does this specific report mention the firm’s prior-year deficiency rate for comparison? ADVERSARIAL: public inspection reports typically do NOT include prior-year numbers.

deficiencies_referencing_going_concern.description: Count of deficiencies in Part I.A whose description mentions 'going concern'. Requires scanning full deficiency text.

has_cybersecurity_related_deficiency.description: Whether any deficiency narrative in Part I.A discusses cybersecurity, data breach, or IT general controls related to security. ADVERSARIAL-LEANING: may be absent in a given year.

cover_page_issuer_header_fields.description: Cover-page header block: exact firm name, firm HQ (city, state), report-type label ('2024 Inspection'), PCAOB release number. Tests cover-page form-region KV binding.

audit_areas_frequency_table_all_rows.description: Full 'Audit Areas Most Frequently Reviewed' table. For each row: audit area, count of audits selected, count of Part I.A deficiencies. Tests row-level binding across three parallel columns with a risk of off-by-one corruption.

inspection_results_by_revenue_range_tabl.description: Each row from the 'Inspection Results by Issuer Revenue Range' chart or table: revenue band, audits reviewed, audits with Part I.A deficiencies, rate percent. Tests chart-to-table binding including percent column.

deficiency_narrative_header_fields_for_f.description: For the first anonymized engagement in Part I.A, the header KV fields that typically label each narrative: issuer category, engagement partner, audit area. Tests dense form-region reading inside a structured narrative header.
